newsitem.title: UK: Jet fighter crashes near British resort pier.
newsitem.headline: Jet fighter crashes near British resort pier.

text.p: A Tornado jet fighter crashed into the Irish sea on Saturday about 60 yards (metres) from an amusement pier packed with holidaymakers at the popular northern British resort of Blackpool, police said.
The pilot and his crew member ejected just seconds before the supersonic, multi-purpose aircraft, hit the water. One of the men landed on shore and the other was picked up by a lifeboat, police said.
Both were taken to hospital, one suffering from back injuries and the other with facial injuries.
The jet, of a type in wide service with the British armed forces, had taken off earlier from a nearby British Aerospace airfield. The cause of the crash was not known.
